title: Concept types
description: Every OKF concept type the target allows: its OKF type string, where it lives, which structure shapes it, and the okfx_ fields it carries.

authored.description: The author may create concepts of this type from inbox documents. Default false.

structures.description: Structure ids this type may use. One entry: always that structure.

structure_rule.description: How to choose among several structures (agents apply this).

path.description: Path pattern under knowledge/. {placeholders} name frontmatter fields or values the guidance defines.

tags.description: OKF tags, in order. {placeholders} are resolved by the author.

fields.description: Frontmatter fields beyond OKF's own. Names must start with okfx_.

identity.description: What identifies one instance of this type. Before writing, the author looks for an existing concept of the type with the same identity and updates it instead of creating another (ADR 0005).

fields.description: Declared fields of this type, or `title`, whose values identify an instance.

match.description: How list values compare: `any` shared item is the same instance (default), `all` needs every item to match.

guidance.description: How to compare values (aliases, case, renamed entities). Applied by the author.

from.description: Where the value comes from (a reference name, a source, a rule).

for_each.description: A list field on the parent; one companion per item.
